summary: Implemented Lambda (vanilla, monai/transforms/utility/array.py) and Lambdad (dictionary, monai/transforms/utility/dictionary.py) with the LambdaD and LambdaDict aliases; added docs entries in docs/source/transforms.rst and tests in tests/test_lambda.py and tests/test_lambdad.py. Per the instructions, nothing was run or installed and nothing was committed, so the tests are unverified. Lambdad copies the input with copy.copy and applies the single callable to each listed key; the callable is never split per key. Docstring examples were checked by hand, not executed.
